results.title: 11 Typical Pharmacy Technician Duties
results.snippet: As a pharmacy technician you will typically be on the frontline, ensuring the smooth operations at the pharmacy. You will greet patients, process their prescriptions, manage inventory and process insurance claims. Your day will be filled with varied tasks, including clinical as well as administrative duties. results.snippet: Pharmacy technicians work under the supervision of pharmacists, who must review prescriptions before they are dispensed to patients. In most states, technicians can compound or mix some medications and call physicians for prescription refill authorizations.
